red_blue.label: Red / Blue
useful_notes: Reliable defensive starter with simple Water coverage.
Needs support against Electric and Grass Pokemon.

yellow.label: Yellow
yellow.availability: Gift from Officer Jenny in Vermilion City after earning the Thunder Badge.
useful_notes: Good long-term Water type for Surf.
Ice Beam gives useful coverage later.

ruby_sapphire_emerald.label: Ruby / Sapphire / Emerald
ruby_sapphire_emerald.availability: Not normally available in Hoenn without trade or event transfer.
useful_notes: If traded in, it fills a bulky Water role.
Competes with many strong Hoenn Water Pokemon.
Still useful because Surf is important throughout the game.
